arms.a: (a) h_S - h_O added at the bridge token at L (X0's whole arm)
arms.b: (b) the bridge token swapped at every layer <= L (block outputs 0..L, and its input embedding)
arms.c: (c) the bridge token swapped at every layer (block outputs 0..n_layers - 1, and its input embedding)
arms.d: (d) every token of the asked pick sentence swapped at every layer (and the bridge's input embedding)
arms.b_blocks: (b) on O's own tokens: block outputs 0..L only, no embedding swap (descriptive)

prompts.swap: O with S's token at the bridge (its input embedding swapped)

states: set (SetRows), from one unedited forward of S (every layer) and O (layer L) on the lookup's prompts
items_rule: each source run's scenes at L (chat), the items its unedited run made eligible; O and S the same length, changed only at the bridge (clean) or the bridge and one other pick token (main); the asked pick sentence at the same positions with the same ids but the bridge's; the readers' prompts equal through the last patched token; else dropped and counted (plan.json)
groups: x45m.group_of: locker-first (both locker sentences before the asked pick), locker-after, mixed

terms.before_L: read before L at the bridge token, (a)->(b)
terms.pick_other: carried by the pick sentence's other tokens, (c)->(d)

read: X0's chat read: the prompt with a digit's space token appended; switch = top token is S's answer

order.items: per design (main, clean), the source run's scene order
order.reads: per item and reader: the arms in ARMS order, one batch (BJ_SUITE_BATCH)
